Subject: Workshop Ground Transport: Chicago (Sept 15-16) — planning kickoff

Hi all,

We (Redwood + Acme) are finalizing ground transport for the Sept 15-16 onsite workshop in Chicago. High level asks:~40 attendees across two half-days, 3 VIP exec arrivals (ORD -> Hilton Downtown), pooled shuttle service for group runs (airport <-> venue windows), reserved executive car service for VIPs (door-to-door), and parking/valet coordination for rental cars and staff vehicles.

Immediate items I need input on: 
- TransitPlus: can you confirm shuttle inventory (35–45 passenger capacity / frequency) and VIP car availability for Sept 15 morning windows? Please also provide estimated costs for: pooled shuttle (per-trip), VIP town car (hourly), and same-day backup rental block pricing.
- Laura: any venue/curb rules (loading dock times, valet bay limits, permit contacts)?
- Anna (Acme): please confirm guest arrival windows and if any VIPs have special security/driver escort requirements.

Attachments: pickup_manifest.csv (template), valet_map.pdf (venue curb map). I will consolidate and produce a final day-of manifest and POC list.

Goal: finalize vendor SOW and rideshare code allocation by EOD 9/7 so travel ops are locked.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

--

Subject: Re: Workshop Ground Transport: Chicago (Sept 15-16) — planning kickoff

Hi Aditya / team,

Thanks for the kickoff. We can cover both pooled shuttle runs and VIP town cars for the stated windows. Quick clarifying questions before I lock pricing: 
1) Confirm origination: ORD only (no MDW pickups)?
2) Preferred VIP car type: Black sedan or SUV (SUV recommended if executive entourages have 2+ people)?
3) Are rideshare codes expected to be managed by Redwood or TransitPlus (we can handle code distribution for business accounts, fee applies)?

Preliminary cost estimates (subject to final passenger manifest):
- Pooled shuttle (40p): $220 per round-trip (airport -> venue -> airport) with 2 trip minimum per day.
- VIP town car (black sedan): $95/hour (4 hour minimum for morning arrivals and city transfers).
- Same-day rental block: we can hold 4 economy sedans at $65/day + 15% on-site pickup admin.

I attached our standard SOW template and an initial pickup manifest example.

Best,
Carlos Medina
Operations Lead, TransitPlus Logistics
ops@transitplus.com

Aditya / Carlos,

Venue notes: the Hilton Downtown has a single curbside load/unload lane and a valet bay that holds up to 6 cars at a time. Loading dock access is between 6:30–9:30AM and 4:30–6:30PM only (strict enforcement). Please plan shuttle drop-offs to use the alternate passenger entrance between 9:00–4:00 to avoid bus congestion.

Parking passes: we can reserve 12 vendor parking passes for TransitPlus/rental cars in the service lot (fee applies - $18/pass/day). I'll attach the most recent valet_map.pdf (updated). For VIP arrivals, hotel security requires driver names and plate numbers 48 hours before arrival for temporary entry badges.

Action items from venue side:
- Laura to provide updated valet_map.pdf (attached).
- Aditya to supply final VIP list + plate numbers by 9/13.

Thanks,
Laura
Event Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and next steps: 

Plan summary: 
- Airport coverage: ORD only (confirmed) with two shuttle waves each morning (6:45–8:15 and 9:30–11:00) to accommodate staggered flights.
- VIPs: 3 execs, black SUV requested for two (one sedan OK) from 7:00–10:00 on 9/15; driver list and plates due 9/13 to Laura (per hotel).
- Rentals: hold 4 economy sedans as TransitPlus backup (pickup at 5:30AM staging lot).
- Parking/valet: reserve 12 vendor passes.
- Rideshare codes: Redwood will allocate codes for late arrivals; TransitPlus to manage livery for scheduled windows.

Aisha — please own day-of onsite check-in (gate, manifest reconciliation, rideshare code distribution). I'll send the draft manifest for your review by EOD 9/5.

Carlos — can you provide a short-day SOW and a line-item invoice for the shuttle + VIP cars by 9/7? We need that for Acme procurement.

Thanks,
Aditya
